name: The Gatekeeper
reference: User: one random Gatekeeper per level, at 240.0 42.0 277.0 facing west; only its defeat completes quest 142 goal 280.
comment: Started by lost_creations.rs as soon as the team arrives (lc script_start arrival; no telegraph): the Gatekeeper stands there from the start (user, 2026-10-29). One spawn per variant (the level copy's variant picks the Gatekeeper). Its adds come from its own skills and never count.
